title: Expose container shipment evidence timeline and tracking workspace
description: Expose the explicit shipment references from ERP-057 and milestone evidence from ERP-058 in existing container workflows and a bounded read-only tracking workspace. Keep planned dates, actual events and missing evidence separately labeled. Do not infer carrier or customs state, mutate source records, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: Container booking, pre-loading and loading-list detail workflows expose their canonical shipment-reference evidence and active milestone timeline through explicit persisted links.

The tracking workspace supports bounded or paged filtering by explicit container, booking, bill-of-lading, route, planned-date and recorded-event fields without fuzzy matching or cross-customer reassignment.

Planned departure and arrival values remain distinct from recorded actual events; a missing event is displayed as none or unknown and is never converted into departed, arrived, cleared, delayed or overdue status.

Any schedule variance is shown only when both comparable persisted timestamps exist, retains their timezone or offset semantics and is labeled as arithmetic evidence rather than a contractual SLA conclusion.
Inspection and release evidence is labeled as user-recorded operational evidence, not an authoritative customs status or permission to ship.
Voided milestones are excluded from the active timeline but remain inspectable in an explicit history view; invalid or unavailable links are visibly marked and never silently repaired.
Shipment lists expose bounded summaries without issuing a database query per row, and different shipment or customer records are never combined solely because their text references match.
The workspace is read-only and does not change container, order, inventory, Trade Document, invoice, expense, finance, tax, customs or settlement records.
Legacy records without shipment evidence remain readable without request-time or production backfill.

Unit/integration tests cover partial and complete timelines, missing and voided events, historical invalid links, multiple customers and routes, bounded queries, no N+1 access and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Open a container with planned dates and recorded departure and arrival evidence, and verify the detail timeline and tracking workspace keep planned, actual and source evidence separately labeled.
Inspect shipments with missing, voided or unavailable milestone evidence and verify they are not presented as departed, arrived, cleared, delayed or overdue and that no source record changes.

human_gate.reason: Read-only presentation of repository shipment evidence. No carrier/customs action, production mutation, deployment or release is authorized.
